# Slow Passport

> Firsthand South Korea travel guides, hiking routes, destination reviews, wellness walks, and practical advice for slower-paced travel.

A personal travel journal publishing firsthand travel guides, hiking routes, destination reviews, and wellness walking experiences across South Korea.

## About

Slow Passport is a personal travel journal publishing firsthand travel guides,
hiking routes, destination reviews, and wellness walking experiences across
South Korea. Articles share practical details from personal visits, including
routes, public transport, trail difficulty, facilities, and preparation notes
when available.

## Topics

- Korea Travel
- Hiking Trails
- Wellness Walks
- Slow Travel

## Published Articles

### Korea Travel

- [Is Mt. Gwanak a Good Mountain to Hike During a Seoul Trip?](https://slowpassport.github.io/posts/korea/gwanak/): A personal hiking guide to Mt. Gwanak from Gwacheon Station, including the route to Yeonjuam Temple, trail tips, and a quiet prayer spot near the summit.
- [Is the Geumsan Wellness Walking Challenge a Difficult Hike?](https://slowpassport.github.io/posts/korea/geumsan-wellness-walk/): A personal review of the Geumsan Wellness Walking Challenge, including its uphill section, event experience, reservation notes, and accessibility considerations.
